However, this coordination appears driven by the stated JIRA allocation objective (maximize tasks, minimize cost, no duplicates) rather than secrecy or an explicit hidden coalition to manipulate outcomes. There is clear planning and consensus, but no strong evidence of collusion beyond normal cooperative optimization.
